title: The direct image of a coherent module along a finite morphism to a locally Noetherian scheme is coherent
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a finite morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] with $X$ locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent] (for instance $\mathcal F=\mathcal O_Y$). Then $f_*\mathcal F$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module; for every affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq X$, with $f^{-1}(U)=\operatorname{Spec}B$, $(f_*\mathcal F)(U)=\mathcal F(f^{-1}U)$ is a finite $R$-module. (Stacks' statement also gives $R^pf_*\mathcal F=0$ for $p>0$; that part is not stated here.)

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01Y6 (lemma-finite-pushforward-coherent), coherence part, with Lemma 01XZ (lemma-coherent-Noetherian)

proof.text: Since f is finite, it is affine and locally of finite type. Mathlib LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian f makes Y locally Noetherian. For every affine open U of X, hU.preimage f makes the inverse image affine, and f.finite_app U hU makes its coordinate ring finite over the base coordinate ring.

proof.text: Apply isCoherent_iff_isQuasicoherent_and_isFiniteType on Y to obtain quasi-coherence and finite type of F. The proved private helper isFiniteType_over restricts finite local generating families: pull the covering back along Over.forget U, and map each generating epimorphism by the slice pushforward, which preserves colimits and the unit. Its index type is unchanged, so remains finite.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01Y6 (lemma-finite-pushforward-coherent), coherence part, with Lemma 01XZ (lemma-coherent-Noetherian)

proof.text: Apply the affine finite-type criterion to F.over (f inverse U), obtaining Module.Finite over the inverse-image coordinate ring. The pushforward sections are definitionally the same abelian group, with the base-ring scalar action restricted along f.app U. Install that algebra and the scalar tower (its compatibility is rfl), and apply Module.Finite.trans with f.finite_app to prove finite base-ring sections.
